description: This file defines an enum called EntityTables that maps various entity names to their database table names, key columns, reference columns, and associated statuses within the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to retrieve entity metadata, filter entities, and access specific attributes related to data query entities used across the application.

classes.name: EntityTables
classes.description: An enum representing different database entity tables with their associated metadata, such as table name, key columns, reference columns, and applicable statuses.

methods.name: getApptableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the corresponding application table.

methods.name: getForeignKeyColumnNameOnDatatable
methods.description: Returns the foreign key column name in the data table.

methods.name: getRefColumn
methods.description: Returns the reference column name in the application table.

methods.name: getCheckStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of status enums that are checked for this entity.

methods.name: hasCheck
methods.description: Indicates whether this entity has check statuses defined.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all entity names.

methods.name: fromEntityName
methods.description: Returns the EntityTables enum corresponding to a given entity name.

methods.name: getForeignKeyColumnNameOnDatatable
methods.description: Static method returning the foreign key column name for given entity name.

methods.name: getCheckStatuses
methods.description: Static method returning check statuses for a given entity name.

methods.name: getCheckStatusCodes
methods.description: Returns a list of status code integers for the given entity name.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Filters the EntityTables enum values based on a predicate.
